pageCache.text:
Small class sizes
High teacher-to-student ratios with individual learning plans for every student, ensuring no one is left behind.
Full curriculum
KS3–KS4 subjects from four London boroughs, with GCSEs, Functional Skills, BTEC and the Prince’s Trust programme.
Therapeutic approach
Group therapy, counselling, art and mindfulness built into every student’s week, supporting the whole person.
Helping young people reconnect with education
Wize Up is an Independent school located within the Royal Borough of Greenwich, offering specialist alternative educational provision for young people — both male and female — aged 11–16 on a full-time and part-time basis.
Founded in 2008, we work with up to 40 young people who have a variety of social, emotional, educational and behavioural needs which could not be fully catered for in mainstream education. We focus on building young people from within, concentrating on modifying behaviour to enable optimum learning potential.
We work with referrals from the boroughs of Bexley, Bromley, Greenwich and Lewisham, operating from two sites in South East London.
“Students speak positively about the school, commenting that they would not be in education if it were not for Wize Up.”
The Wize Up Way
Understanding the young person. Creating the conditions for progress.
Rated Good by Ofsted
Wize Up Independent School is proud to have been judged ‘Good’ by Ofsted. To read our latest inspection report, please click the link below.
